=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:P1 Files, P2 Files, Rollout line 413 (workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:103-148,352-356,382-399) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan claims the P1/P2 switches (WORKFLOW_HEAL_LINKED_RUN_SCOPE_ENABLED, WORKFLOW_HEAL_SCRIPT_CLOSURE_ENABLED, WORKFLOW_HEAL_SCRIPT_CLOSURE_RESERVE) are plumbed through existing workflow env blocks, but the workflow lists variables by name and has no such entries, and the P1/P2 file lists omit the workflow yml.
  WHY: The switches never reach the jobs, so rollback via repo variable does nothing and heal_scope_render_version() in the scan jobs cannot reflect operator choice, which breaks the render= re-arm. Severity disagreement: gemini rated BLOCKER, the others MAJOR; the highest is used.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:P3 step 1 (lines 299-312), denied=/render= exclusion bullets | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The rescope candidate select is specified as a pure jq select, but jq cannot compute sha256 of the denied paths or the render version, and the plan defines no helper or CLI operation for either.
  WHY: needs_human and replaced markers would not suppress repeat processing, so G4 idempotency and the render= re-arm cannot be implemented as written. Severity disagreement: anthropic rated NIT, minimax and glm MAJOR; the highest is used.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:linked_scope.json format (lines 116-134) and P2 step 4 (line ~292-294) | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: P2 step 4 applies the pr_scope fork check to linked seeds, but linked_scope.json does not record the run's repository.full_name, so the comparison target is undefined.
  WHY: An implementer may skip the comparison or add an extra API call, which could let a foreign-head linked seed into closure seeding. Severity disagreement: gemini rated MAJOR, the others NIT; the highest is used.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:P3 step 1 "Count." paragraph (line 309) / Interfaces (P3) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The log line gains `rescope=<n>`, yet the plan says the output is "unchanged" with the switch off, which contradicts G6's byte-for-byte promise.
  WHY: Contract tests pinning the heal_scope_recovery count= line would fail unless the field is emitted only when the switch is on. Severity disagreement: gemini rated MAJOR, the others NIT; the highest is used. glm judged the plan's own clause as resolving this.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Rollout and G6: "each switch defaults on; consumer repos get no behaviour change" and "switching it off restores today's output byte-for-byte"
  expected_change_site: docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md P1 and P2 phases (workflow env step like P3 step 4, in .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: P1 and P2 "Files" list only the two scripts and have no step naming the workflow file, jobs and env vars; the workflow has no grep matches for the three switch names
- requirement: "Each phase ships its own changelog.d/<N>-<slug>.md and an agents.d/<N>-<slug>.md fragment."
  expected_change_site: P1, P2, P3, P4 Implementation steps
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The PR diff (original_pr_diff.patch) introduces no fragments in changelog.d/ or agents.d/ for the phases defined in the plan
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:Rollout bullet 1, P1 Files, P2 Files and step 4 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The existing env blocks in workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml list variables by name and have no entry for WORKFLOW_HEAL_LINKED_RUN_SCOPE_ENABLED, WORKFLOW_HEAL_SCRIPT_CLOSURE_ENABLED or WORKFLOW_HEAL_SCRIPT_CLOSURE_RESERVE; the plan plumbs env only for P3 and P4.
  WHY: The switches are unreachable, so rollback fails, and heal_scope_render_version() in the recovery-scan jobs can differ from the intake's value and corrupt the render= re-arm.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:P3 step 1, denied=<sha256-12> and render=<n> bullets; Interfaces row ai:heal-rescope:v1 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The plan does not say where the sha256 of the sorted denied paths or the render= value is computed, and jq has no sha256 function.
  WHY: The jq select cannot compare marker fields to current values, so replaced and needs_human markers may not suppress repeat processing.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:P2 step 4 linked_scope.json seed bullet and linked_scope.json format | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The pr_scope check compares head_repository.full_name with the run's repository.full_name, but linked entries store no repository field.
  WHY: Skipping the comparison would let a linked run with a fork head repository be seeded.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:P3 step 1 "Count." paragraph | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: "The log line gains rescope=<n>; with the switch off ... the output is unchanged" is self-contradictory.
  WHY: Contract tests pinning the heal_scope_recovery count= line would fail with the switch off unless the field is emitted only when on.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:Rollout section and Interfaces section (P1-P3) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The plan claims the switches are plumbed through existing env blocks but defines no wiring in .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml.
  WHY: Without the env mapping the switches are unavailable in the jobs, so P1/P2/P3 cannot be rolled back via env and the heal logic runs without proper control.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:Interfaces section (P3) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The plan adds rescope=<n> to the recovery scan log line unconditionally, regardless of HEAL_SCOPE_RESCOPE_ENABLED.
  WHY: This violates G6's byte-for-byte requirement and breaks contract tests that pin the log line.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:linked_scope.json format section and P2 step 4 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: P2 step 4 applies a fork-comparison PR-scope check, but the linked_scope.json format does not record the run's repository.full_name.
  WHY: The comparison target is undefined, so a foreign-head linked seed could be eligible for closure seeding and widen the heal scope.
- TASK_GAP: requirement: "Each phase ships its own changelog.d/<N>-<slug>.md and an agents.d/<N>-<slug>.md fragment."
  Expected change site: P1, P2, P3, P4 Implementation steps
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff (original_pr_diff.patch) does not introduce any fragments in changelog.d/ or agents.d/ for the phases defined in the plan.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:299-309 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: P3 step 1 asks for a second candidate list from a jq select, but jq cannot compute the per-candidate render version or the denied=<sha256-12> hash, and no CLI operation returns either (existing filter at scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:184-193 is pure jq).
  WHY: An implementer would hardcode placeholders, so processed candidates slip through (defeating G4 idempotency) or fresh ones are excluded (breaking the render= re-arm).
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:243-250, 413 vs .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:103-148,352-356,382-399 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: P1 and P2 list no workflow env edits, while the Rollout paragraph claims existing env blocks carry the switches; WORKFLOW_HEAL_LINKED_RUN_SCOPE_ENABLED, WORKFLOW_HEAL_SCRIPT_CLOSURE_ENABLED and WORKFLOW_HEAL_SCRIPT_CLOSURE_RESERVE appear nowhere in .github/workflows/*.
  WHY: The switches are inert, P1 and P2 cannot be rolled back without a revert, and heal_scope_render_version() returns 1 in the scan jobs regardless of operator choice.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:116-134, 294 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: linked_scope.json records parent_run_id, event, head_branch and head_repository but not repository.full_name, which the pr_scope check needs; the plan never states that linked seeds compare against SELF_REPO.
  WHY: An implementer may leave the comparison target missing or add a per-candidate API call that breaks the "no new API call" budget.
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:309 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Adding rescope=<n> to the log format string unconditionally changes the line even when the count is 0, contradicting "output is unchanged" and G6.
  WHY: The contract test pinning the existing log shape would fail with the switch off, and the sentence is ambiguous about which surface is unchanged.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: PR description Rollout "each switch defaults on; consumer repos get no behaviour change" and G6 "switching it off restores today's output byte-for-byte."
  Expected change site: docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md P1 (~line 245) and P2 (~line 250), matching P3's "Workflow env" step at line 318.
  Evidence of absence: P1 and P2 "Files" list only the two scripts and have no step naming the workflow file, jobs and env vars. The Rollout paragraph (line 413) claims existing env blocks carry the switches, but grep across .github/workflows/* finds no matches for the three variables.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- docs/plans/heal-scope-linked-runs-script-closure-plan.md:P1 rollback line 245, P2 rollback line 250, Rollout line 413; workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:103-147 and :382-413 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The plan promises repo-variable rollback for P1/P2, but the workflow does not map WORKFLOW_HEAL_LINKED_RUN_SCOPE_ENABLED, WORKFLOW_HEAL_SCRIPT_CLOSURE_ENABLED or WORKFLOW_HEAL_SCRIPT_CLOSURE_RESERVE, and P1/P2 omit that wiring.
  WHY: Setting a switch to false in repository variables never reaches the intake job, so the feature cannot be rolled back and the reserve cannot be configured.
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

  PROBLEM: P1 and P2 plan no workflow edit and P3 step 4 plumbs only HEAL_SCOPE_RESCOPE_ENABLED, so the Rollout claim of existing vars.* env blocks is false and the three switches never reach the heal, recovery-candidates or recovery-scan jobs.
